title: Some saved Resources lose their script
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.5.dev [bd94fc7] and later snapshots.
Not reproducible in 4.5.dev [51b1775] and earlier 4.5 snapshots.

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (bd94fc7c1) Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 04 Jun 2025 18:52:35 +0000

### Issue description

When creating a Resource that contains another Resource as one of its exported properties, the defined script of the contained Resource will be removed upon reloading project. If this file is opened in editor after reloading a project, the script will not be known to the inspector, and saving over it will erase all properties of it, with the exception of ```metadata/_custom_type_script```, which does not appear to be picked up by its uid, and remains a blank resource with no script according to the inspector.


I have narrowed down the cause of this to commit bd94fc7, as all snapshots prior to this work without this issue, and from this one all the way to current it has this same isue.

### Steps to reproduce

Create the following script:

```gdscript
class_name ResTest
extends Resource


@export var a_test: int = 42
```


Then create the following other script:
```gdscript
class_name TestTres
extends Resource


@export var something: ResTest = null
```


in your FileSystem in editor create a new `TestTres` and save its .tres file somewhere.


Open that .tres file, set its "something" property to a new `ResTest`, and maybe even edit the exported property found within that, then save.


Click on Project -> Reload Current Project


Attempt to open that .tres file now, see that its script is missing and its exports are now gone.


If you save at this point those exported properties will also be removed.
